# Feature Requirements Quality Checklist: Interactive Airport Data Platform

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of the full feature requirements, with attention to hosted-model privacy, budget, and analytical safety.
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are the supported analysis areas and the boundary between weather-as-delay-context and a separate analysis area explicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-014]
- [x] CHK002 - Are source-data coverage, snapshot identity, and required data-quality disclosures defined sufficiently to make reports reproducible? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-004, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 - Are report requirements complete for metric definitions, units, populations, periods, counts, limitations, and relevant analytical-term explanations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK004 - Are authentication, analyst identity, and unauthenticated or unknown-user access requirements stated in the specification, not only in the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, §FR-031]
- [x] CHK005 - Are hosted-provider data processing and application FAQ/report reuse represented as distinct purposes with distinct disclosures or consent requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019–FR-023, §FR-028]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Is the allowance for a “free plan” clearly distinguished from the deployment-wide maximum of USD 10 in metered charges per UTC calendar month? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024–FR-025]
- [x] CHK007 - Is “maximum possible charge” defined with enough precision to establish which token limits, retries, provider fees, taxes, currency conversion, late invoices, and in-flight requests count before a hosted call is authorized? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK008 - Are the provider disclosure contents and timing clear when provider terms, model selection, or content-improvement practices change during a session? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028–FR-029]
- [x] CHK009 - Is “minimum required context” specific enough to distinguish permitted question/schema or aggregate-result content from prohibited source rows and private history? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 - Do the structured-plan, allowlist, and query-compilation requirements apply consistently to every supported model provider and every report-generation path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024–FR-027]
- [x] CHK011 - Are restrictions on sending analyst identity or private history to hosted models consistent with the separately consented reuse of identifiable questions and reports? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK012 - Are budget-exhaustion and provider-outage messages consistent with the explicit local-model switch option and the prohibition on silent provider switching? [Conflict, Spec §FR-025, §FR-029; User Story 1, User Story 5]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the USD 10 cap consistently described as deployment-wide, UTC-calendar-month, and inclusive of every cost category the requirements intend it to cover? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024–FR-025, §FR-030]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 - Can report correctness be judged against an identified set of representative questions and independently defined expected results, rather than an unspecified sample? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK015 - Do success criteria objectively measure whether the shared budget blocks concurrent or uncertain-cost requests before charges can exceed the cap? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK016 - Are there user-centered acceptance criteria for the hosted-provider disclosure and explicit choice to switch to local inference after budget exhaustion? [Completeness, Spec §SC-009; User Story 1]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 - Are the primary, follow-up, clarification, unsupported-data, and empty-result journeys complete from the analyst’s perspective? [Coverage, Spec User Stories 1–3 and 5]
- [x] CHK018 - Are first use of each hosted provider, a provider change, and subsequent calls in the same session covered by clear disclosure requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028–FR-029]
- [x] CHK019 - Are initial decline, later opt-in, withdrawal, re-enable, and a new session covered without ambiguity about which content may be reused? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019–FR-023]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for concurrent hosted calls competing for the remaining monthly allowance, including failures and unsettled reservations? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK021 - Are retry, timeout, partial-response, and provider-reported-usage discrepancies addressed without risking duplicate charges or cap overruns? [Gap, Spec §FR-025, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK022 - Are long, malformed, or otherwise out-of-bounds analyst questions covered by explicit input and cost-control requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-025–FR-027, §FR-032]
- [x] CHK023 - Is the analyst-facing recovery path specified when the budget is exhausted and no configured local model is available? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025; User Story 1]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK024 - Are latency, concurrency, and availability targets either measurable or explicitly excluded from the MVP acceptance scope? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context, Spec §FR-034, §SC-010–SC-011]
- [x] CHK025 - Are privacy requirements complete for storage, access, retention, deletion, and handling of retained shared artifacts and consent records? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §FR-019–FR-023, §FR-035]
- [x] CHK026 - Are accessibility and localization expectations stated or deliberately excluded for the analyst-facing application? [Gap, Spec §FR-033, §SC-012]
- [x] CHK027 - Are acceptable data-quality thresholds or explicit per-report coverage and disclosure rules defined for unmatched joins, missing values, and weather associations? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008–FR-012, §FR-036, Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 - Are the hosted-provider selection criteria, free-tier quota assumptions, applicable terms, and model-quality acceptance threshold documented before a provider is selected? [Dependency, Plan §Design Decisions, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK029 - Are identity-provider configuration and responsibilities for analyst authentication documented as deployment dependencies? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK030 - Are assumptions about single-host operation, dataset size, and the absence of live updates aligned between the spec and plan? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions; Plan §Technical Context]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK031 - Does the specification consistently explain that provider product-improvement disclosure is not the same as consent to reuse content for platform FAQs or system improvement? [Consistency, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019–FR-023, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK032 - Is the meaning of “total metered inference charges” unambiguous about fees, taxes, currency conversion, and charges posted after the UTC month ends? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024–FR-025]
- [x] CHK033 - Are model narrative-generation inputs and output-evidence rules clear enough to prevent unsupported numeric claims without accidentally sending unnecessary private data? [Clarity, Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §FR-027]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- CHK025 is reviewer-approved: FR-035 explicitly requires owner-approved retention periods and deletion procedures before production reuse and keeps reuse disabled until approval.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
